messages:
Maya (People Ops): Heads up - Sam filed an accommodation request around office lighting, chair height, and needing a predictable hybrid day each week to manage sensory fatigue. They also asked for private feedback channels. Posting here to coordinate.
Liam (Manager): Thanks Maya. Sam, I’m sorry this has been hard. Can you list the exact equipment/changes you’re requesting so I can get approvals?
Sam (IC): Quick list: 1) dimmable desk lamp + monitor hood, 2) ergo chair with adjustable armrests, 3) one guaranteed remote day per week (Thu), 4) when giving corrective feedback, DM me first rather than in team channel.
Jordan (Hiring Ops): FYI if Thu remote day overlaps interviews I’ll shuffle panels. We have two candidate onboards next week; I can move them to Tues/Wed.
Liam (Manager): Good call. I’ll accept the Thu remote day. For interviews: Sam, do you want to sit out panels on your remote day?
Sam (IC): Yes please. If you need coverage, here’s a simple coverage note I used before:
```coverage: {"date": "2026-08-05", "remote_day": "Thu", "coverage_contact": "Avery"}```
Liam (Manager): I can assign Avery as backup for calendar holds.
Ellen (HR Partner): I’ll run the intake and confidentiality flow. Proposed steps: (a) intake form DM to Sam, (b) provisional equipment order and remote day approved for 30 days, (c) manager coaching on private feedback, (d) accommodation recorded in HR system.
accom-bot: Accommodation intake created (ID: AC-202345). Status: Pending HR intake. :lock:
Maya (People Ops): Reminder: this is an accommodation, not performance action. Liam, please avoid connecting the accommodation to any PIP or corrective plan.
Liam (Manager): Understood. I’ll keep performance notes separate and will not reference the accommodation in reviews.
Jordan (Hiring Ops): I’ll update the interview schedule and remove Sam from panels on Thu for the next 4 weeks. Notifying panel leads now.
Sam (IC): One more thing - captioning on meeting recordings helps a lot. Can we enable live captions by default for product demos?
Ellen (HR Partner): Good ask. I’ll coordinate with IT to turn on captions for recorded sessions involving the product team.
Maya (People Ops): Action items: Ellen to send intake & confirm 30-day provisional approval, Jordan to adjust interview panels, Liam to set backup coverage and stop public corrective notes, IT to enable captions (Ellen to own). Check-in in 30 days. :white_check_mark:
Sam (IC): Thanks all. Appreciate the quick turnaround and the privacy on this.
Liam (Manager): Thanks Sam. I’ll DM you the plan and confirm the equipment order tomorrow. 
Ellen (HR Partner): Intake DM sent to Sam.
Maya (People Ops): Closing loop for now - will schedule the 30-day review on the calendar.
